observations: Photo 0: Blue PlayStation 4 Slim console box/cover with large “10” and “PS4” style graphics; looks like it’s wrapped/covered with protective plastic or film.
Photo 1: Same blue PS4 Slim box/cover; a dualshock-style controller placed in front (blue/gray camouflage design).
Photo 2: Another angle of the blue PS4 Slim box/cover; controller shown again; no console, ports, or screen shown.

read_from: photo 0 (PS4 Slim text/branding on the blue box/cover)
photo 2 (PS4 branding on the blue box/cover)

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a blue PS4 Slim-themed/custom design on the box/cover and matching camouflage-style controller.
No game discs/cases, storage screenshots, or game list is shown in photos 0-2.

claims.claim: Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.
claims.evidence: No visible game titles, discs, or screenshots confirming FIFA/PES 2027 in photos 0-2.

risks.risk: The listing may be showing only the box/cover and not the actual working console (photos don’t show the console itself).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual PS4 Slim console (front ports/USB area and model label) plus a short video of it powering on to the home screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: console not confirmed/untested (discount heavily vs a confirmed working PS4 Slim).

risks.risk: Games may be missing, not the claimed titles, or may be installed via account/illegal copies (or not playable).
risks.proof: Photos of the game discs/cases OR screenshots of the installed games list on the PS4 home screen showing the exact titles; also show storage usage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: no confirmed games included.

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/condition: the controller shown could be a third-party/custom shell, and functionality (sticks/buttons) isn’t testable from photos.
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected and working (button presses, analog stick movement) and a photo of the controller model/label on the back.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: controller condition/compatibility not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Console health issues (overheating, noisy fan, faulty HDMI/ports) can’t be assessed remotely from these photos.
risks.proof: Power-on video + brief gameplay or system menu navigation; show fan noise and that HDMI output is stable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: may need repair/has unknown performance.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 Slim console (not just the box/cover): front ports/USB area and the model/serial label.
Short video: console powers on and reaches PS4 home screen.
Screenshot/photo of the installed games list showing the exact titles (including FIFA and PES 2027 if claimed).
If games are discs: photos of all 10 discs/cases.
Video test of the controller (buttons + both analog sticks) and a back label photo.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4 Slim-themed blue setup and a controller, but they do not show the actual console or any proof of the claimed 10 games. Without power-on and game-list proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
